name: Planet Coaster 2: Bonus Ride Collection
summary:
The Planet Coaster 2: Bonus Ride Collection contains three thrilling rides designed to give your guests an extra boost of fun:

FD Vision – Powered Rotating Ride: A classic rotating ride of the much-adored omnimover variety, the FD Vision never truly stops! This powered ride consists of a chain of vehicles operating on a fixed speed track that must be boarded and disembarked on the move via its accompanying conveyor belt.

The Cube: Bear witness to the tumbling terror of geometry that is the Cube! Your guests will twist, spin and squeal with glee amidst the rides numerous rotating squares.

Outamax – Water Coaster: This tall and speedy water-based coaster uses a unique double life elevator to propel your guests from one massive splash to the next.
